fact: The Université Nazi Boni UniPod, a university technology innovation hub open to startups and entrepreneurs, was inaugurated on 9 November 2026 in Bobo-Dioulasso, with the president saying a dedicated team would be set up to run it.
title: Bobo-Dioulasso : L'Université Nazi Boni inaugure un UniPod de 365 millions de FCFA au service de l'innovation technologique
